import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'])

# Adding annotations for each point to show the Vintage year
for i, txt in enumerate(df['Vintage']):
    plt.annotate(txt, (df['Preqin Median Net IRR'][i], df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'][i]), fontsize=8, alpha=0.7)

plt.title('Correlation between Preqin Median Net IRR and LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')
plt.xlabel('Preqin Median Net IRR')
plt.ylabel('LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')
plt.grid(True)
# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Preqin Median Net IRR', 'y_fields': ['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], 'chart_type': 'scatterChart'}
plt.show()
